About

The Agency

Behind Wayora

Wayora Paris was born from a passion for travel and an undeniable love for the city of Paris, where our founders were born and raised. The agency was created to design tailor-made trips in Paris, by Parisians.

That is exactly what makes the difference: we know every corner of the city, we know the best prices, and we know the best logistics to make each day efficient, so you can enjoy and see as much as possible in the time you have. We build these tailor-made trips with love and passion, because travel often matters deeply: it means a budget, and sometimes it is the trip of a lifetime. Everything needs to be carefully organised so that nothing is left to regret, so you can live a stress-free trip, with everything planned in advance and direct assistance from someone on the ground. It is truly about making the journey easier for anyone who wants to visit one of the most beautiful cities in the world.

[First name], Founder

Our Services

We take care of everything, you enjoy Paris.

From your first coffee to your last dinner, we organise everything from A to Z: your day-by-day itinerary, activities, accommodation, restaurants, transfers, logistics, a French phrasebook and every practical detail of getting around. Our goal is simple: to turn your trip into a moment of pure relaxation and pleasure, with no stress at all, backed by direct assistance on the ground to handle any problem or emergency for you. Everything is possible and fully personalised, from a photoshoot to any special request you can imagine.
